verdict.rationale: The evidence for earning on idle balances is thin. The docs list 'cash rewards' as a financial-account feature in the prebuilt embedded components. A community thread refers to Treasury's 'interest-earning feature for platform-held balances' but openly asks who gets paid the interest. That suggests some yield capability exists, while showing the payout mechanics are not clearly documented. missing for 10: documented interest rates or how they are set, sweep options, an explicit explanation of who keeps the spread (platform vs. Stripe vs. end user), and in-depth first-party docs on the earning mechanism.
